content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Erika Bolton (E002) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write. Says admin only if role owns system; Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist; Analyst max is write.
- Security note: role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommendation read. Security DB shows contractor, max read for contractors with basic training, write requires advanced training, admin never permitted.

Conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. The policy says:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Security DB check shows contractor with basic training. So max is read. Requested admin, which is above max (read), so grant max = read.

I'll submit read.
